subject.title: [Data] Quality signals for ClawHub Skills — we analyzed the top 50 and found trust gaps

question: Should ClawHub introduce a public multidimensional skill-quality signal, and if so what dimensions and advisory boundaries should it have?
rationale: The request would create new public trust semantics that could affect user install decisions, ranking, and moderation interpretation; source inspection shows no current contract that automation can fill in safely.

options.title: Design advisory quality signals first
options.body: Keep this open for maintainers to define dimensions, provenance, freshness, and separation from security/moderation before implementation.

options.title: Fold into security policy RFC
options.body: Route the remaining discussion into the broader content-policy thread if maintainers want one canonical trust-policy venue.

options.title: Decline public scoring
options.body: Close later if maintainers decide ClawHub should keep quality scoring internal or outside the registry product.

recommendation.title: Design advisory quality signals first
recommendation.body: Keep this open for maintainers to define dimensions, provenance, freshness, and separation from security/moderation before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: The current implementation and CODEOWNERS evidence point to this handle for backend trust-surface and security-boundary decisions.
